Image 1 is the identity/outfit reference for the existing game's ADULT Rukia Kuchiki character. Preserve her adult face, short black bob, white snowflake two-piece bikini, pale blue trim, white forearm guards and white ankle boots; keep the same polished painted anime linework and eight-head adult anatomy. This is a neutral technical animation asset, not a glamour illustration. Create ONE full-body figure in a relaxed riggable A-pose: three-quarter view facing screen right, torso upright, shoulders level, both arms extended DOWN and OUT about 25 degrees away from the torso, both elbows almost straight, relaxed empty hands clearly separated from hips, legs separated enough to leave a clear transparent gap from upper thighs to feet, both knees nearly straight, weight centered, both low-heeled boots flat on the same baseline. No action pose and no foreshortening; all joints visible and natural. Full body and feet fully in canvas with margins. Place the figure in the left 75% of a tall portrait canvas. In the far right 20%, draw her white katana as ONE separate isolated vertical weapon, hilt above and blade tip down, with a transparent gap to the figure; the blade must never cross or overlap the body. Do not draw magic, glow, auras, cast shadows, floor, backgrounds, text, labels, charts, borders, or extra poses. Avoid arms touching torso, overlapping limbs, hair covering joints, oversized eyes, exaggerated anatomy and shiny skin. Preserve actual transparency around every part. The result will be bound to continuous arm, leg, foot, spine and weapon bones in Unity.
